The '''Fand sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Isis system]], which was home to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. The Isis system was situated near the [[Bowane nebula]].<ref name="TIC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Fand sector and the Bowane nebula were excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because later sources placed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Isis in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
